name: Beard maxxing
lead: Beard maxxing is the looksmaxxing practice of growing, shaping or enhancing facial hair to change how the lower face and jawline appear. Community members describe a beard as one of the cheapest and most visible changes a man can make, and discuss styles aimed at framing the jaw, disguising a weak chin or short ramus, or adding perceived masculinity [1][2].

Beard growth is driven by androgens, mainly dihydrotestosterone, and is partly genetic [3]. Methods discussed in the community range from grooming and styling to topical minoxidil and, in medical practice, beard hair transplantation [4][5]. Evidence on how beards affect attractiveness is mixed and the wiki records both what proponents and what researchers report.
infobox: Shaving reverses it; transplant is surgical

paras: Beard maxxing covers keeping stubble or a full beard, choosing a shape that complements face structure, and trying to improve patchy growth. Forum users discuss beard styles for particular facial structures, for example a thread on styles for a short ramus [6].

Wikipedia describes beards as secondary sexual characteristics, stimulated by DHT, with growth rate partly genetic [3]. Their fashion history is cyclical: Hadrian was reportedly the first Roman emperor to wear a full beard, Peter the Great ordered Russian men to shave in 1698 and taxed beards in 1705, and beards surged in mid-19th-century Europe before declining in the early 1900s and returning briefly in the late 1960s [3].

sections.h: Effects on appearance and research views
paras: According to Wikipedia, clean-shaven faces are rated less dominant than bearded ones, facial hair appears to influence male attractiveness, and scholars disagree whether beards evolved mainly through attractiveness or dominance signalling [3]. The article does not report specific studies of how women rate beards [3].

Reviews describe growing demand for facial hair transplantation, using follicular units, usually taken from the scalp, to fill sparse areas of the beard [4][5]. Beard reconstruction techniques are also described in trichology literature [7]. A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled study of minoxidil 3% lotion for beard enhancement was published in the Journal of Dermatology in 2016 [8]; minoxidil's mechanism in hair is not fully understood, according to a review [9].

Shaving-related skin conditions are a documented concern: pseudofolliculitis barbae is a chronic inflammatory condition from attempts to remove beard hair, reported to affect up to one in five Caucasian individuals in some studies and much more commonly black individuals [10].

A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled study examined 3% minoxidil lotion for beard enhancement [8]. Hair-transplant literature on beard reconstruction consists mainly of technique reviews [4][5][7]. No studies were found testing beard styling specifically for jawline appearance.

timeline.event: Peter the Great orders Russian men to shave; a beard tax follows in 1705 [3].
Beards become fashionable in Europe after the revolutions of 1848 [3].
Randomized trial of minoxidil 3% lotion for beard enhancement published [8].

lore.intro: Beard maxxing is a frequent topic on looksmax.org, with opinion divided on whether beards enhance or conceal facial structure [1][2][11].

claims.claim: A beard is among the easiest, cheapest big looksmaxes
claims.believers: One poster says a beard signals physical maturity and masculinity, especially at young ages, and describes receiving many compliments after growing one [11].
claims.experts: Wikipedia reports that bearded faces are rated more dominant than clean-shaven ones and that facial hair appears to influence male attractiveness, though researchers disagree about the underlying evolutionary reasons [3].

claims.claim: A beard only helps men with recessed or weak jaws; stubble is better otherwise
claims.believers: Other posters reply that a beard is only useful for recessed features and that stubble is better, and warn that overly long facial hair can look worse [11]. A thread on beard styles for a short ramus reflects the same idea of camouflage [6].
claims.experts: No published studies have tested beard shape for jawline perception in this way.

claims.claim: Patchy beards can be improved with minoxidil or transplants
claims.believers: Forum threads discuss minoxidil and related drugs for beard growth [12].
claims.experts: A randomized placebo-controlled study of 3% minoxidil lotion for beard enhancement exists [8], and reviews describe beard hair transplantation as a growing surgical option [4].

card.summary: Growing and shaping facial hair to frame the jaw; cheap and reversible, with mixed research on attractiveness.
card.note: Shaving can cause pseudofolliculitis barbae; transplants are surgical.

quick.overview:
Beard maxxing means growing, trimming or enhancing facial hair to change how the lower face looks. Forum users call it one of the cheapest looksmaxes and discuss styles for different jaw shapes.

Research cited by Wikipedia suggests bearded faces are rated as more dominant, but how beards affect attractiveness is not settled.
quick.mechanism: Beard growth is driven by androgens such as DHT and genetics. A beard adds a hair outline to the jaw and chin, which proponents say changes how the lower face reads. Medical options for sparse growth include minoxidil (studied in one placebo-controlled trial) and beard hair transplants.
quick.risks: Beard grooming carries minor risks such as ingrown hairs; pseudofolliculitis barbae is a documented shaving-related condition. Transplants are surgery with the usual procedural risks.
